title: WordPress Maintenance
meta: A starter sprint of updates, backups, security checks and fixes for your WordPress site. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: WordPress maintenance, a first round of care
overview: This is a fixed starter sprint, not a subscription. We back up your site, update WordPress, themes and plugins on a staging copy, check for broken pages and security gaps, clean out spam and unused plugins, and fix what we find. You get a plain report of what was done and what to watch. If you want us to keep doing this each month, we quote monthly care separately.
